newsitem.title: USA: Californians sent notices on Prudential settlement.
newsitem.headline: Californians sent notices on Prudential settlement.

text.p: California's Insurance Department said on Tuesday notices were being sent to Prudential Insurance Co policyholders in the state who may be entitled to cash compensation as part of a settlement it imposed on Prudential last month.

The settlement affects about 10.5 million policyholders across the nation and 750,000 policyholders in California who purchased life insurance from Prudential Insurance between January 1982 and January 1995.

"This week, California Prudential policyholders will receive a letter informing them that they may be entitled to cash compensation if they were misled when they bought their policies," state Insurance Commissioner Chuck Quackenbush said in a statement.
California policyholders will have until June 1 to file their claims.
